name: When should I consider professional help for sliding door drafts instead of DIY fixes?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider professional help for sliding door drafts instead of DIY fixes?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor draft issues like re-applying a basic seal can be DIY, professional help is advisable for persistent drafts, complex problems, or when you're unsure of the cause. Professionals can correctly diagnose issues with rollers, tracks, or the door's structural integrity, ensuring a lasting repair. Incorrect DIY fixes can sometimes worsen the problem or lead to more costly repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider professional help for persistent drafts, complex problems, or if you're unsure of the cause, as incorrect DIY fixes can worsen issues.
